steps.expr: E8 branches under A2 x E6 as 248 = (8,1)+(1,78)+(3,27)+(3bar,27bar); on container 12's 240 roots this is 240 = 6(A2) + 72(E6) + 162((3,27)+(3bar,27bar)). The (3,27) is 3 copies (an A2-triplet) of the E6 27, and 27 = 16+10+1 of SO(10) with the 16 the SO(10) spinor = one SM generation (with nu_R). So E8 -> E6 x SU(3) yields (27,3) = 3 GENERATIONS of matter -- a real, celebrated branching
steps.what: Surface A -- E8 > A2 x E6 EXISTS: 248 = 8+78+3*27+3*27; 240 = 6+72+162; the (3,27) = 3 copies of the 27; 27 = 16+10+1 (16 = one SM generation) -> 3 generations of matter
steps.why: Surface A engaged honestly and at full strength -- this IS the standard, beautiful E8 route to three generations, and the substrate HAS E8 (12). The decomposition is exact group theory (Lean checks the dimension and root bookkeeping). Taken at face value it looks like a derivation of 3 generations of SM matter. ST.2 asks whether the SUBSTRATE forces it, or whether it is generic.

steps.check: Surface A: generic to all E8 + A2 Weyl-arbitrary (31) + exotics unprojected -> a lead, not a forcing
steps.determines: UNIQUE (E8 route is generic + Weyl-arbitrary + unprojected -> a filed lead, NOT a forcing)
steps.expr: Surface A is a filed PARALLEL, not a forcing: (i) GENERIC -- the branching 248 = (78,1)+(1,8)+(27,3)+ (27bar,3bar) holds for EVERY theory built on E8; it is a property of E8's representation theory, not of THIS substrate. Erase 'generation' and 'SM' (G3) and nothing substrate-specific remains. (ii) WEYL-ARBITRARY -- container 31 established all A2 subgroups of E8 are Weyl-transitive (1120 checked), so the embedding singles out NO distinguished colour-or-family A2; the choice is arbitrary. (iii) UNPROJECTED -- the substrate forces neither matter=(3,27) (vs the adjoint (8,1)+(1,78) or the conjugate) nor the removal of the 27's EXOTIC states (the 10+1 beyond the generation 16). G4: no refuter -- any E8 theory reproduces this. So E8 is a promising LEAD, never banked

value.exotics_unprojected: the 27's 10+1 beyond the 16 are not projected by any substrate rule
value.grade: filed PARALLEL / lead -- fails G3 (generic/renaming), G4 (no refuter); NOT banked

steps.what: ...but Surface A does NOT FORCE the SM content: (i) GENERIC to every E8 theory (G3 renaming); (ii) the A2 is WEYL-ARBITRARY (31, 1120 checked); (iii) the 27's exotics (10+1) are UNPROJECTED. A filed lead, not a forcing
steps.why: the disciplined verdict on the most seductive route in the whole program -- neither fit nor dismiss. It is NOT dismissed: E8 -> E6 x SU(3) giving 3 generations is real and the substrate has E8, so it is a genuine lead, filed as a PARALLEL. It is NOT banked: it fails the gates as a FORCING -- generic to all E8 (G3 renaming), the A2 Weyl-arbitrary (31, no distinguished embedding), and the exotic states unprojected by any substrate rule (G4/G5: no refuter, no forced selection). This is exactly where the refused-list is at maximum: an E8-GUT match is the easiest renaming in physics. So: a lead, held; not a substrate forcing of the SM content.

steps.check: regular rep dim 120; outer-Z/3 -> 3 blocks of 40; 3^1||120 (substrate-specific count 3)
steps.determines: UNIQUE (regular rep 120; outer-Z/3 generation -> 3 blocks of 40; 3^1||120 forbids Z/9)
steps.expr: the regular representation C[2I] has dimension sum d_i^2 = 120 = |2I|. Under generation = the OUTER Z/3 (left-multiplication by an order-3 element g3, which is fixed-point-free), it splits into EXACTLY 3 equal blocks of 40 (40/40/40). The count 3 is a SUBSTRATE-SPECIFIC divisibility fact -- 3^1 || 120 (3 divides 120, 9 does not) -- so the generation grading cannot enlarge to Z/9. This is genuinely a property of 2I (|2I| = 120 = 2^3 * 3 * 5), NOT a generic-E8 statement

value.substrate_specific: 3^1||120 is a property of |2I|=120, not generic-E8

steps.what: Surface B -- the regular rep C[2I] (dim = sum d_i^2 = 120) under generation = the OUTER Z/3 (left-mult, fixed-point-free) gives EXACTLY 3 blocks of 40; count 3 is substrate-specific (3^1||120), not generic-E8
steps.why: Surface B, the substrate-specific one. Unlike the E8 route (generic), the outer-Z/3 generation grading is a fact about 2I in particular: left-multiplication by an order-3 element is fixed-point-free, giving 3 blocks of 40, and 3^1 || 120 forbids enlargement. So IF generation is the outer Z/3, the count is exactly 3 -- forced, and forced by this substrate, not by generic E8 group theory. This is the one piece of K2 with a real substrate handle on a NUMBER.

steps.check: generation block 40 != SM 15/16; no forced fermion selection -> content unforced on B
steps.determines: UNIQUE (generation block = 40 != SM 15/16; no forced selection of the fermions within a block)
steps.expr: the count is not the content. One generation block is 40 states; one SM generation is 15 Weyl fermions (16 with nu_R). 40 != 15 and 40 != 16 -- the block is LARGER than one generation's fermion content (it presumably carries gauge and other degrees of freedom too), and NO substrate principle selects which of the 40 are the matter fermions with which colour/isospin/hypercharge. So Surface B fixes the generation COUNT but not the multiplet CONTENT
steps.what: ...but Surface B does NOT force the CONTENT: one generation block is 40 states, one SM generation is 15 (16 w/ nu_R); 40 != 15, 40 != 16, and no substrate principle SELECTS which states are the fermions
steps.why: the honest limit of Surface B. The regular rep gives 3 generation blocks, but a block (40) is not one SM generation (15/16) -- so the content within a block is not determined by the grading alone, and there is no forced rule picking 'the fermions' out of the 40. This is the same open selection K2 has always been: the count is handled, the content is not.

steps.determines: POSTULATE (K2 open: content unforced by either surface; count 3 near-forced via the outer Z/3 identification)
steps.expr: the honest verdict of the surface test. The CONTENT of K2 (which multiplets, which hypercharges) is NOT forced by either surface: A is generic to every E8 theory (a renaming, not a substrate forcing) and the A2 is Weyl-arbitrary; B has no forced selection of the fermions within a 40-block. What DOES have a genuine, substrate-specific handle is the generation COUNT 3 -- the outer Z/3 (left-mult) + 3^1||120 -- but this is CONDITIONAL on the identification generation = the outer Z/3, motivated by the triadic floor (00/A3, three roles) yet not proven, and it is a REDUCTION to that identification, not a cold forcing. So K2 stays OPEN: partly structured (the count 3, near-forced), partly open (the content, unforced) -- NOT an irreducible root, NOT solved, NOT refuted

value.status: K2 OPEN -- not a root, not solved, not refuted; partly structured

steps.what: (verdict, POSTULATE) neither surface forces the SM CONTENT (A generic/renaming; B no forced selection); the generation COUNT 3 has a genuine substrate handle (outer Z/3 + 3^1||120), conditional on generation = the outer Z/3. K2 OPEN -- not a root, not solved, not refuted
steps.why: the corrected, disciplined standing after actually running the test. This neither re-declares K2 a root (the retracted over-claim) nor bangs an E8-GUT match (the over-affirmation twin). The truth in the middle: the substrate has real handles (a substrate-specific generation count 3; a generic E8 embedding as a lead) but forces no SM CONTENT. The generation-count 3 is the strongest genuine result -- and it is a reduction to 'generation = the outer Z/3', which links generations to the triadic floor, the deepest axiom (00). Whether that identification is forced is the live question. No downstream premise rests on this reading.

steps.determines: OWED (a content-selection principle; a non-generic E8 reason; the generation=outer-Z/3 identification)
steps.expr: OWED: (a) a substrate principle that SELECTS the multiplet content -- which fermions, with which quantum numbers -- which would force K2 and then cascade (theta_W, hypercharges, masses) or refute; (b) a substrate reason to pick THIS A2 in E8 and matter = (3,27) (and to project the exotics), which would make the E8 route non-generic -- a real forcing rather than a lead; (c) the identification generation = the outer Z/3 made rigorous (currently the count-3 reduces to it). Generations-count-3 is a REDUCTION to (c), never fished; no content is assembled to the SM (the refused-list binds)

value.owed_content: a substrate principle selecting the multiplet content (forces K2)
value.owed_e8: a substrate reason for THIS A2 + matter=(3,27) + exotic projection (non-generic)
value.owed_generation: generation = the outer Z/3 made rigorous (the count-3 reduces to it)

steps.what: OWED: a principle that SELECTS the multiplet content (forces K2 -> cascade/refute); a substrate reason to pick THIS A2 + matter=(3,27) (make E8 non-generic); the generation=outer-Z/3 identification made rigorous
steps.why: the honest residual. The test is run; the result is that neither right surface forces the content, and the E8 route -- the most tempting -- is a generic lead, not a forcing. What would move K2: a genuine selection principle (content), a non-generic reason for the E8 embedding, or a proof that generation IS the outer Z/3 (count). Until then K2 is open and partly structured, and the discipline holds: the E8 3-generations match is filed as a lead, not banked.

values.finding: THE K2 SURFACE TEST (Kevin: 'go'), target out of view, refused-list at MAXIMUM. Surface A (E8 > A2 x E6): 248=8+78+3*27+3*27, 240=6+72+162, (3,27)=3 copies of the 27, 27=16+10+1 -> 3 generations of matter (ST.1) -- a real, celebrated branching. BUT it does NOT FORCE the SM content (ST.2): GENERIC to every E8 theory (G3 renaming), the A2 WEYL-ARBITRARY (31, 1120 checked -> no distinguished embedding), the 27's exotics (10+1) UNPROJECTED (G4 no refuter) -- a filed LEAD, never banked. Surface B (regular rep C[2I], dim 120): generation = the OUTER Z/3 (left-mult) -> EXACTLY 3 blocks of 40; count 3 substrate-specific (3^1||120) (ST.3); but a block (40) != one SM generation (15/16) and no principle selects the fermions -> content unforced (ST.4). VERDICT (ST.5): neither surface forces the CONTENT; the generation COUNT 3 has a genuine substrate handle (outer Z/3 + 3^1||120), conditional on generation = the outer Z/3 (a reduction, motivated by the triadic floor 00/A3, not proven). K2 stays OPEN -- partly structured (count 3), partly open (content) -- NOT a root, NOT solved, NOT refuted. OWED (ST.6): a content-selection principle; a non-generic E8 reason; the generation=outer-Z/3 identification. Nothing fitted; the E8 GUT match is a lead, held.
